title: ESC-Fault: a simulated benchmark for electrostatic chuck fault diagnosis
description: Simulated sensor data from electrostatic chucks (the part of a semiconductor etch or deposition tool that clamps and cools the wafer), with a physics-based simulator, baselines and scoring. v1: 140 chucks, about 125,000 wafers, 7 classes including a sensor-fault decoy. v2: 552 chucks, about 490,000 wafers, a new arcing fault, overlapping faults (multi-label), a tool-shift test split and a data-size study. Three causal tasks (diagnosis, early detection, remaining life) with held-out test labels. Full data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/forgottenl5/esc-fault-benchmark
